(async()=>{const W=(await import('/js/flight/world.js')).W, E=await import('/js/core/engine.js'), THREE=await import('three'); const rt=W.reflectRT, w=rt.width, h=rt.height; const buf=new Uint16Array(w*h*4); E.renderer.readRenderTargetPixels(rt,0,0,w,h,buf); const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=w; c.height=h; const g=c.getContext('2d'); const im=g.createImageData(w,h); for(let y=0;y<h;y++) for(let x=0;x<w;x++){ const i=((h-1-y)*w+x)*4, o=(y*w+x)*4; for(let k=0;k<3;k++){ const f=THREE.DataUtils.fromHalfFloat(buf[i+k]); im.data[o+k]=Math.min(255, Math.pow(Math.max(0,f),1/2.2)*255); } im.data[o+3]=255; } g.putImageData(im,0,0); window.__rtimg=c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.85); return window.__rtimg.length})()
